newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fairwood in HK$83 mln rights issue plan.
newsitem.headline: Fairwood in HK$83 mln rights issue plan.

text.p: Fast food chain operator Fairwood Holdings Ltd proposed to raise HK$83 million before expenses by way of a rights issue of not less than 237.24 million new shares at HK$0.35 per rights share, the company said in a statement published on Wednesday.

The rights share will be allotted in the proportion of one rights share for every two existing shares held. Fairwood's issued share capital was 474.473 million shares as on September 3, it said. Goodwill Capital Ltd is the manager of the issue.
Fairwood shares closed at HK$0.54 each on Monday prior to a one-day suspension on Tuesday. Trade will resume on Wednesday.

Net proceed of HK$80 million will be used to finance its capital investments in opening six new shops in Hong Kong and China in the current financial year, and to repay banks borrowings reducing its gearing level and interest expenses.
The proposal is conditional on shareholders approval at a special general meeting on September 27.

Fairwood operates a 95 fast food restaurants chain under the name Fairwood and a chain of 28 Italian restaurants under the name Mario in Hong Kong. It also operates 24 Fairwood outlets and one Mario restaurant in China and Macau.
